skills.skill: Solve addition and subtraction word problems to 100 in a familiar context

misconceptions.pattern: Chooses the wrong operation for the story at two-digit size — adds when the situation takes away, or subtracts when it joins, often cued by a surface word rather than the action.

strategies.intent: Name the action in the story first — join or take away — then add or subtract the two-digit amounts; the action, not a keyword, picks the operation.
